items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 167:1
items.html: In a place where there is the rooting of the second restriction, there is the reality of a coupling to correct the broken vessels and bring them out of the Klipot. And this begins in YESHSUT, from the Chazeh [chest] of AVI and downward, in the secret of the Vav of the filling of the HaVaYaH of SAG. See above, answer 36. (Item 18).
